name: prime-cost-and-margins
title: Prime Cost & Margins (analytics module 1)
description: Implement the Prime Cost & Margins analysis endpoint per the A6 contract. Includes: monthly_financial_summary table (daily rollups), COGS calculation (inventory_movements + purchase_orders), labor cost (time_logs × salary/160), prime_cost_pct, GET /api/v1/analytics/prime-cost endpoint with all time buckets (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly).
acceptance: V33 migration: creates monthly_financial_summary table (period_key, bucket, net_sales, gross_sales, discounts, comped, cogs_food, cogs_beverage, cogs_alcohol, cogs_other, food_cogs_pct, labor_foh, labor_boh, labor_total, labor_pct, prime_cost, prime_cost_pct, updated_at TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(period_key, bucket))

MonthlyFinancialSummary domain record
MonthlyFinancialSummaryRepositoryPort + JPA entity + adapter
RollupDailyJob: @Scheduled @SchedulerLock cron that aggregates yesterday's orders + purchases + inventory movements into a daily monthly_financial_summary row
COGS calculation: Σ(inventory_movements.quantity * supply_variant.unit_cost) grouped by supply_category.food_type (FOOD/BEVERAGE/ALCOHOL/OTHER), filtered to movements between period start/end
Labor cost calculation: Σ(time_logs.hours * user.salary / 160) grouped by user.area (FOH/BOH via FK to areas table). If salary is NULL, skip that worker with a warning log.
Net sales calculation: Σ(order_details.unit_price) - discounts - comped for orders in period
GetPrimeCostUseCase port + GetPrimeCostService (reads from monthly_financial_summary, returns a series for the requested time bucket range)
PrimeCostController: GET /api/v1/analytics/prime-cost with Bearer auth + @PreAuthorize(ADMIN)

PrimeCostResponseMapper (domain → DTO)
No BigDecimal-in-domain violations (§6b): all monetary amounts use Money wrapper; category percentages stay BigDecimal (not money)
No Spring/JPA in domain/ (§6)
Tests: RollupDailyJob aggregates correctly (mock inventory, orders, time_logs); GetPrimeCostService returns series for daily/weekly/monthly/yearly; controller returns 200/401/403

name: public-jwks-endpoint
title: Public JWKS endpoint at /.well-known/jwks.json
description: Expose the public half of the API's signing keys in RFC 7517 JWKS format at GET /.well-known/jwks.json. Supports single-key (backwards compatible) and multi-key rotation via env vars. Adds deterministic kid derivation (SHA-256 of public key DER), kid header on all generated JWTs, and a Nimbus JWKSource-based JwtEncoder. No new dependencies needed.
acceptance: JwtConfigValidator extended to read single-key and multi-key env vars without breaking existing deployments
Every RSAKey built in SecurityConfig carries a kid derived by JwkKeyIdDeriver.from(publicKey)
JwtServiceImpl includes the kid JWS header on every generated token (access, refresh, TFA)
GET /.well-known/jwks.json returns RFC 7517-compliant JSON, public material only (no d, p, q, etc.)
Endpoint is in permitAll() of SecurityConfig (production branch) — reachable without auth
Content-Type: application/jwk-set+json
Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600 + ETag set
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header present
CORS open for this path
ProblemDetail (RFC 7807) returned on 503 when no keys configured
./harness/harness.sh exits 0
